description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for verifying that all classes declared in the OrangeHRM project follow a specific namespace pattern related to testing. It includes a single test method that iterates over declared classes and matches their fully qualified names against a regex pattern to identify namespace violations.

classes.name: UnitTestsNamespaceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that checks all declared classes to ensure their namespaces conform to a specific pattern related to the testing namespace structure.

methods.name: testUnitTestsNamespace
methods.description: Iterates over all declared classes to identify any that do not match the expected namespace pattern for test classes, and throws an exception if such classes are found.
